/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short
git log -5 --oneline
ls
rg --files -g AGENTS.md
wc -l funcy/funcy/*.py parse/parse/__init__.py pyrsistent/pyrsistent/*.py schema/schema/__init__.py'
/bin/zsh -lc "for f in funcy/funcy/*.py; do rg -n '"'^'"' \""'$f" | sed "1s|''^|$f |"; done'

/bin/zsh -lc 'for f in pyrsistent/pyrsistent/{_field_common,_pbag,_pclass,_plist,_precord,_pset,_transformations}.py; do ls "$f"; rg -n '"'def |if |elif |return | += | -= |raise ' \""'$f"; done'
